brief:
Authorities demolished a structurally unsound apartment building in Shati refugee camp west of Gaza City, the Ma'an news agency reported. The building, which had been at risk of collapse, was brought down as part of efforts to address dangerous structures in the crowded camp.

Details about the demolition operation and the circumstances leading to the decision were not immediately available.
title: Demolition crew levels deteriorating building in Gaza's Shati camp
